entities.name: Query protein PrsA
observations: 320 aa bacterial protein; predicted molecular weight 34.6 kDa and theoretical pI 5.82.
Shares 59.9% identity over 97.5% of its length with reviewed Rhodopirellula baltica ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase Q7UPM4.
Shares about 53% identity over 97% of its length with reviewed Firmicute ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinases Q8R753 and Q899I8.
Pfam matches support a phosphoribosyltransferase-related architecture: Pribosyltran_N, Pribosyltran, and Pribosyl_synth regions.
Function is inferred from strong homology; the query itself was not experimentally characterized.

entities.name: Ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase
observations: Catalyzes formation of 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate (PRPP) from D-ribose 5-phosphate and ATP, producing AMP and proton; EC 2.7.6.1, Rhea RHEA:15609.
Reviewed homologs bind two Mg2+ ions per subunit and form homohexamers.
Reviewed homologs are cytoplasmic and participate in PRPP biosynthesis, purine nucleotide biosynthesis, and ribonucleoside monophosphate biosynthesis.

entities.name: PRPP biosynthesis
observations: Ribose-phosphate pyrophosphokinase performs the first and only step of the route-I conversion of ribose-5-phosphate to PRPP.
